Determine the Article Flow steps 34–35

In the live system these answers come from the values already captured; questions are asked only for missing values. Click through to see how each answer leads to an Article.

All Articles possible for this nature of document

ArticleInstrumentWhen it appliesDutyMin Max
20(1)Conveyance (general sale / transfer)Conveyance u/s 2(d) not covered by 20(2)-(7) and not a transfer under Art 525% of market value of the property (higher of consideration and MV)
20(2)Conveyance of Flat / Apartment / Unit by promoter / developer, or share transfer for unitPRP-06 = Yes AND executant is promoter / land owner / developer OR transfer of share in co-op society / companySame as 20(1) on MV of fully constructed flat / apartment / unit (deemed fully constructed)
20(3)Conveyance of Flat / Apartment by BDA / KHBPRP-06 = Yes AND executant = BDA / KHBRates of 20(2) on amount / value of consideration set forth
20(4)(i)Amalgamation of companies (court / NCLT order)CMP-04 = AmalgamationHigher of: 3% of MV of transferor's Karnataka property; OR 1% of aggregate value of shares + consideration
20(4)(ii)Reconstruction / Demerger (court / NCLT order)CMP-04 = Reconstruction / DemergerHigher of: 3% of MV of transferor's Karnataka property; OR 1% of aggregate value of shares + consideration
20(5)(i)Conveyance of industrial machinery - movablePRP-08 = Movable3% of consideration or MV, whichever higher
20(5)(ii)Conveyance of industrial machinery - immovablePRP-08 = Immovable5% of consideration or MV, whichever higher
20(6)Assignment of receivables to SPV (securitisation)PRP-01 = ReceivablesRe. 1 for every Rs. 1,000 or partRs. 1,00,000
20(7)Conveyance of Transferable Development RightsPRP-01 = TDR3% on higher of MV of TDR (MV of corresponding portion of property) or consideration
